latest_release.name: ARVIO 2.4: Redesigned mobile, smoother TV
latest_release.body:
## Android

- **Redesigned phone and tablet experience.** Updated Home, Details, Sources, Library, Calendar, profiles, add-on browsing and touch controls. The new bottom navigation fades into the content. Choose an immersive full-width or inset poster hero on mobile; portrait artwork and centered title logos now match Details. Long-press an episode to mark it watched or choose a source.
- **Smoother TV browsing.** Reduced unnecessary row redraws and focus work on Home and in Settings without removing animations. Netflix-style cards keep the same artwork as they expand, with a readable title fallback. Streaming-service collections use the same browsing layout, list newest titles first, and offer a separate genre-filtered grid.
- **Easier TV setup and discovery.** Scan a QR code to type into supported TV settings fields from a phone. Show optional add-on stream descriptions in the source list, sort discovery results without setting another filter, and customize visible tabs per profile with Cloud sync.
- **More control for families and trackers.** Parents can approve individual titles and collections for kids' profiles. WeTrakr lists are available in Library and Add to List, with optional recommendations on Home. Trakt and MDBList connection errors are clearer, and Telegram Settings show the connected account.
- **More reliable playback.** Improved recovery after long pauses, network or decoder failures, and source changes. Reuse trailers more efficiently, with better memory budgeting, a larger back buffer, and an adaptive, configurable disk cache.
- **Better IPTV connection handling.** Set a device-side connection limit per playlist or portal. The app counts sessions rather than individual requests, releases the previous channel before tuning, and avoids speculative VOD requests on capped accounts. Home previews retain per-channel headers; VOD respects quality limits and tracks matched titles even when duration is still unknown.
- **AI subtitles and localization.** On Live TV, Gemini translates available channel captions first and uses audio when captions are unavailable. Added Claude Haiku as a translation provider and improved repair of lines in the wrong script. Expanded Spanish and Hebrew translations, and fixed episode dates and English metadata ordering in right-to-left layouts.
- **Add-ons and catalogs.** Safer add-on sync keeps configuration separate from refreshable metadata; compatible add-ons can delegate catalogs, filtering and IPTV VOD lookups to the client.
- **16 KB Android compatibility.** Updated the GitHub build's add-on TLS library to avoid an unsafe native memory boundary on ARM64 devices with 16 KB pages.
- **GitHub APK only:** Search YouTube and use YouTube results as sources, subject to the profile's parental controls. This feature is not in the Play build.

## ARVIO Web, Cloud and Website

- Add Xtream Codes directly from TV Settings. Improved authentication and proxy fallback, kept guide settings and XMLTV headers intact, and made live reconnection and connection limits more predictable.
- Added MDBList device sign-in, improved default WeTrakr setup for self-hosting, fixed empty Home loading loops and nested collection folders, and hardened playback against malformed source metadata. Reduced memory pressure on iPhone Safari's Sports page.
- Improved Cloud profile restore and synchronized navigation visibility. Updated checkout and regional pricing presentation, recovery for pending annual upgrades, confirmed-payment referral rewards and Premium Discord badges.
- Refreshed the website's download and Web links, Hebrew localization, diagnostics and not-found pages. Web and backend changes are delivered separately from the Android release.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@silentbil](https://github.com/silentbil), [@Himanth-reddy](https://github.com/Himanth-reddy), [@galinosT](https://github.com/galinosT), [@OrlS15](https://github.com/OrlS15), [@CaptainMusX](https://github.com/CaptainMusX)

detail.readme:
ARVIO

Your media, together. On TV, phone, tablet and the web.

An open-source media hub for your home servers, live TV, collections and connected sources.

[![Watch ARVIO: a looping preview of the TV home, phone and tablet apps, the new Music tab, AI subtitles and ARVIO on every screen.](netlify-arvio-tv-site/assets/promo/arvio-tour-preview.gif)](https://arvio.tv/#demo)

Watch the 34-second film · Download in 1080p (720p)

Website · Setup guides · Discord

**ARVIO includes no movies, series, live channels or third-party subscriptions.** Connect your own authorized services and sources. Catalog artwork and listings are for discovery, not a grant of access to the content. [Get ARVIO](#get-arvio) · [Features](#features) · [Get started](#get-started) · [Collections](#make-it-yours) · [Self-host](#self-host-arvio-web) · [Build](#build-from-source) · [Contribute](#contributing) ## Get ARVIO

| Where you watch | How to get it | | --- | --- | | Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets | **Free app.** Install from Google Play where available, or download the signed APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/releases/latest). | | Your own computer or server | **Free self-hosting.** Run the web app with Docker Compose or Node.js and your own integration credentials. [Setup instructions](web/README.md). | The GitHub APK supports Android 6.0+; the Play build requires Android 7.0+. The standard APK contains ARMv7 and ARM64 builds. Device, codec and service support can vary. For GitHub updates through Obtainium, add `https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO` as the app source. The [Obtainium guide](docs/distribution/OBTAINIUM.md) includes an import file and APK filtering instructions. **What's new?** See the [latest release notes](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/releases/latest) and [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). This README and the tour describe the current `main` branch, which can include improvements not yet in a published APK. Features can differ between Android, web and distribution builds. ## Features - **A home screen you can make your own.** Choose the expanded-card TV home or the classic layout, arrange catalogs and collections, show your watchlist beneath Continue Watching, and enable optional trailer previews. The TV home shows real posters in every row, a clear focus ring, rows that scroll endlessly and a billboard that rotates through today's top titles. - **Your colours.** Pick an accent colour for the whole app, now including Coral, Amber, Teal, Cyan and Pink. Your choice syncs between the Android app and the web app. - **Collections and discovery.** Browse built-in collections or import your own. Collection pages include artwork, title previews, descriptions and ratings where available. Add compatible TMDB pages, Trakt, SIMKL and MDBList lists, or add-on catalogs. Each catalog in an imported collection folder gets its own row on Home. - **Your library and release Calendar.** Keep watchlists, personal lists and home-server libraries together. See upcoming movies and episodes from supported lists and shows you are watching, with local-time schedules where an air time is known. - **Plex, Emby and Jellyfin.** Connect your own servers or libraries shared with you, browse their contents and use available server media as playback sources. - **Music.** A Music tab on Android for your own music. Connect Navidrome or another Subsonic server, Jellyfin, or compatible music add-ons (including the Eclipse add-on format). Browse daily charts and playlists for your app language, search songs, albums and artists, like songs, save favourite albums and build your own playlists. Bring your Spotify playlists and liked songs over from a Spotify data export file. Music keeps playing in the background, with lock-screen and Bluetooth controls, and your music sources, likes and playlists sync per profile with ARVIO Cloud. - **Live TV and catch-up.** Connect supported M3U, Xtream Codes or Stalker sources. Browse categories, favorites, recently watched channels and the programme guide, with a mini-player and fullscreen playback. Guide coverage, catch-up and seeking depend on your provider. - **Sports inside Live TV.** Browse live and upcoming events, then choose a matched channel or compatible sports add-on source. Use IPTV, sports add-ons, or both. Coverage and artwork depend on the schedules and sources available to your setup. - **Add-ons, debrid and Telegram.** Browse and install compatible community add-ons, configure supported debrid sources, or search video files in your connected Telegram channels and groups. These services need their own configuration and access. - **Trakt and SIMKL tracking.** Connect accounts per profile for supported watchlists, history, scrobbling and Continue Watching/next episodes. SIMKL uses AUTH V2 for new connections; custom-list availability depends on your SIMKL account's capabilities. - **Playback and subtitles.** Media3 playback on Android, episode-aware controls, source selection, audio/subtitle tracks, automatic frame-rate matching on supported hardware, subtitle language preferences and optional AI subtitle tools. - **Profiles and optional cloud sync.** Separate viewing state, avatars and PINs, plus age-filtered kids profiles on Android. ARVIO Cloud can sync supported settings, catalogs, playlists, music and watch state across your devices. Browser playback depends on the source, CORS, codecs and browser. It is not a guarantee that every source playable on Android will play in a browser. See the [browser playback guide](https://arvio.tv/browser-playback-guide/). ## Get Started 1. **Install and create a profile.** Use local profiles, or connect ARVIO Cloud for supported cross-device sync. 2. **Connect your sources in Settings.** Add your home server, a compatible add-on, your live TV playlist or Telegram account. Browsing a catalog alone does not create a playable source. 3. **Connect your trackers.** Add Trakt or SIMKL for viewing progress and supported lists; connect MDBList if you use its lists. 4. **Make Home yours.** Choose your layout, organize catalogs and import collections. Open a title and select an available source to watch. 5. **Add your music (optional).** Open the Music tab and connect your music server or a music add-on. Import a Spotify export file to bring your playlists along. [All setup guides](https://arvio.tv/guides/) · [Plex / Emby / Jellyfin](https://arvio.tv/plex-emby-jellyfin/) · [Ask the community](https://discord.gg/UavuEYMfQ4) ## Make It Yours **Catalogs** are rows of titles, such as a trending feed or a personal list. **Collections** organize supported catalogs and discovery sources into browsable folders with their own artwork. Use [Collection Studio](https://arvio.tv/collection-studio/) to create a collection, then import its JSON in Settings. You can also paste a supported collection document or a direct JSON URL hosted on GitHub or another public host. **Direct file uploads are not supported yet.** - [Create, host and import collections and catalogs](https://arvio.tv/collections-catalogs/) - [Collection format, supported sources and examples](docs/custom-collections.md) - [Release Calendar behavior and supported sources](docs/library-calendar.md) - [SIMKL V2 and custom-list setup](docs/simkl-v2-and-custom-lists.md) Imported collections do not include streaming access. You still need your own sources, and any subscriptions required by the connected service. ## Self-Host ARVIO Web ARVIO Web is the browser version for desktop, iPhone, iPad and TV browsers. **Self-host it on your own computer or server** with Docker Compose or Node.js, using your own TMDB key and optional integration credentials. For Node.js, install **Node.js 22.19+** and Git, then: ```sh git clone https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO.git cd ARVIO/web npm ci npm run setup:selfhost ``` Edit `.env.local` and set your own TMDB API v3 key as `TMDB_API_KEY`. Keep this file private. Then: ```sh npm run check:selfhost npm run build npm run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 ``` Open **http://localhost:3000**, create a local profile and connect your sources in Settings. For Docker Compose, configuration details and updates, follow the [web README](web/README.md). Read the [self-hosting guide](web/docs/SELF-HOSTING.md) before exposing it to your network or the internet; the commands above bind only to the local computer. Self-hosted profiles and settings are local to each browser; this mode does **not** provide ARVIO Cloud cross-device sync. Connected Trakt/SIMKL accounts can still synchronize the data those services support. Media and access to third-party services are not included. ## Help and Support - **Setup help and discussion:** [ARVIO Discord](https://discord.gg/UavuEYMfQ4) and [guides](https://arvio.tv/guides/). - **Bug reports:** [open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/issues/new/choose) with the app version, device/OS, install source, steps to reproduce and expected behavior. Include a crash reference or redacted logs when available. - **Feature requests:** describe the workflow you want to improve and check [existing issues](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/issues) first. Never post passwords, API keys, tokens, private playlist URLs or unredacted account information in an issue or screenshot. ## Build From Source This repository contains the Android app, web app, public website and supporting services. Android uses Kotlin and Jetpack Compose; web setup is documented separately in [web/README.md](web/README.md). ### Android Development Requirements: **JDK 17**, **Android SDK 36**, Android Studio or the SDK command-line tools, and the tracked Gradle wrapper. ```bash git clone https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO.git cd ARVIO cp secrets.defaults.properties secrets.properties # Configure the integrations you want to test in secrets.properties. ./gradlew :app:assembleSideloadDebug ``` On Windows PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO.git cd ARVIO Copy-Item secrets.defaults.properties secrets.properties # Configure the integrations you want to test in secrets.properties. .\gradlew.bat :app:assembleSideloadDebug ``` The debug APK is written to `app/build/outputs/apk/sideload/debug/`. For an x86/x86_64 emulator, add `-PincludeX86Abis=true`; APK builds otherwise include ARMv7 and ARM64. Use your own TMDB, Trakt, SIMKL, Telegram and other application credentials for the integrations you test. Placeholder values do not provide working authentication. Cloud/auth features also require appropriate backend configuration. Keep `secrets.properties`, keystores and signing credentials out of Git. **Test on an emulator or dedicated device.** Ordinary debug builds use the production package ID but a different signing key, so they cannot update an official signed installation. Do not uninstall a user's app just to install a debug build.
Build variants, optional SDKs and release verification ### Variants and Installation | Variant | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `play` | Google Play distribution; in-app self-update disabled. | | `sideload` | Direct APK distribution; in-app self-update enabled. | | `debug` | Development build with debugging enabled. | | `staging` | Release-like beta in the separate `com.arvio.tv.beta` package; uses release signing when configured, otherwise debug signing. | | `release` | Optimized production build. Configure your own private release keystore before distribution. | ```bash ./gradlew :app:installSideloadDebug ./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug ./gradlew :app:testSideloadDebugUnitTest ``` For an emulator, include `-PincludeX86Abis=true` in the build/install command. For a network-connected test device: ```bash adb connect :5555 adb -s :5555 install -r app/build/outputs/apk/sideload/debug/app-sideload-debug.apk ``` ### Optional Integrations Discord Rich Presence requires Discord's separately licensed Android Partner SDK. Place the approved AAR at `app/libs/discord_partner_sdk.aar` and configure `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID`. Builds without it remain valid and show Discord as unavailable. Do not commit or redistribute the SDK without the required permission. The speech-recognition AAR is downloaded and checksum-verified by Gradle. Integration availability can differ by distribution: for example, Sync by Hearing is currently a sideload feature. Debug builds disable crash reporting. Fork maintainers should use their own Firebase client configuration before distributing builds. See [Firebase diagnostics](docs/firebase-diagnostics.md) for configuration, consent and symbol-upload instructions. ### Release Verification Copy `keystore.properties.template` to `keystore.properties`, configure a private release keystore, and keep both out of version control. A locally built APK does not share the official release signing key. ```bash ./gradlew :app:testSideloadDebugUnitTest ./gradlew :app:assemblePlayRelease ./gradlew :app:assembleSideloadRelease ./gradlew :app:bundlePlayRelease ``` Smoke-test startup, profile switching, playback, source fallback, audio/subtitles, IPTV/EPG, add-on management, search, settings, sync and repeated player open/close on the supported device classes. Complete the [release content/rights checklist](docs/play-copyright-release-checklist.md) before publishing.
## Contributing Bug fixes, tests, translations, documentation and accessibility improvements are welcome. Open a focused pull request, explain the change, and include testing details and screenshots for UI work. Discuss larger changes in an issue first. Keep credentials and private media out of submissions. Public demo assets need documented permission. AI-assisted contributions are welcome under the same review and testing standards as other changes; ARVIO itself has been developed with significant AI assistance. Thank you to [all contributors](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/graphs/contributors), testers, translators and community members. Individual release credits are preserved in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and [release notes](https://github.com/ProdigyV21/ARVIO/releases). ## Credits, Privacy and License This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Other integrated services, trademarks, SDKs and artwork belong to their respective owners; compatibility does not imply endorsement. The optional Kaptain collection import example retains credit to [Kaptain / ImKaptain](https://github.com/ImKaptain) and [Kaptain Collection](https://github.com/ImKaptain/Kaptain-Collection). See [collection credits and reuse notes](docs/custom-collections.md#collection-credits). ARVIO's built-in collection queries are maintained separately. - **Privacy and cloud data:** [Privacy policy](PRIVACY.md). Cloud account and synced-data deletion is available at [auth.arvio.tv/delete](https://auth.arvio.tv/delete). - **Content and copyright:** ARVIO does not host, sell or distribute movies, series, channels or streams. Metadata and artwork do not grant viewing rights or permission to reuse an image. Use sources you are authorized to access. Report concerns about ARVIO-controlled material or links through [COPYRIGHT.md](COPYRIGHT.md); independently hosted material may also need reporting to its provider. - **License:** [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) for this project. Third-party components and assets retain their own terms.
